sn3.5:1.4: For “protect themselves” (_rakkhito attā_) compare _rakkhitatta_ at [sn6.13:2.4](), [thag2.11:2.4](). The use of the term _attā_ here is conventional, not metaphysical. “Personal safety” ( _ātmarakṣā_) is a paramount concern of kings (eg. Arthaśāstra 1.1.3, 1.21.30, 5.4.16, 7.3.24, 9.6.40, 12.2.10).
